It does not alter the NPI-masking contract, access control, or any other product-obligation code; the only product obligation in scope is LOG-1, whose control test passed in CI. All process obligations are satisfied: the ticket is approved with the correct component, an independent code_review and a security_review (required because the component is security_sensitive) were given by qualified non-author reviewers on the final commit, CI ran on that commit with 124 tests all passing, and no acceptance-ledger evidence is lapsed.
